seeds.title: RACE: Large-scale ReAding Comprehension Dataset From Examinations
TriviaQA: A Large Scale Distantly Supervised Challenge Dataset for Reading Comprehension
HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
DROP: A Reading Comprehension Benchmark Requiring Discrete Reasoning Over Paragraphs

selection: Four named reading-comprehension benchmark source papers chosen before new page responses/labels to supplement independent train DATASET documents, not by dev/test errors, labels, scores or rare-name targeting of held-out sets. Targeted training selection is biased, not a representative evaluation sample.
identityPolicy: Before fetching, compare arXiv IDs and normalized title metadata against the whole canonical 20000-paper identity registry and current train titles/IDs. Reject any existing canonical identity rather than force train or fabricate a new paper group. Exact/normalized metadata comparison does not certify exhaustive semantic near-duplicate detection. No held-out abstract or label access.
collection: Official arxiv.org /abs citation metadata; preserve raw HTML and exact Unicode abstract; current robots checked, minimum15.1s serial delay; match normalized source title and ID, max512tokens without truncation; disclose failure/mismatch/overlength, no automatic replacement or retry.
annotation: Reuse whole-abstract METHOD/TASK/DATASET and flat BIO plus round44 source-scope policy. Fresh per-document AI generation then actual same-session self-review. Evidence-only positive assertions; unresolved pairs never default negative. Background dataset mention alone is not evaluation. Reference labels are AI pseudo, not independent gold.
